subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be limited to documenting the current pi-tui multiline shortcuts, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already supports multiline input through the dependency, but exposing a new config or CLI preference changes OpenClaw's public UX/config contract and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Document current behavior first
options.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and the backslash fallback without adding a new config surface yet.

options.title: Add a supported keybinding preference
options.body: Define and implement a public TUI send/newline preference with config schema, help text, docs, and upgrade-safe tests.

options.title: Close as covered by existing shortcuts
options.body: Treat current pi-tui behavior as sufficient and leave configurable keybindings to broader composer/editor issues.

recommendation.title: Document current behavior first
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and the backslash fallback without adding a new config surface yet.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits show the strongest overlap with TUI docs, custom-editor behavior, CLI-adjacent TUI work, and dependency updates.
